question.q: She managed to ________ a wonderful dinner despite the limited ingredients.
question.justification: إذا كان أحمد طاهياً ماهراً، فهو يطبخ (cook) جيداً. الأكل (eat) صفة من يتناول الطعام، والشرب (drink) للسوائل، والتنظيف (clean) للنظافة.
question.context_sentence: She managed to ________ a wonderful dinner despite the limited ingredients.

question.q: The head ________ of the hotel restaurant trained in Paris.
question.justification: الطاهي (chef) يعمل في مطبخ المطعم. النادل (waiter) يقدم الطعام، والسائق (driver) يقود، والمزارع (farmer) في الحقول.
question.context_sentence: The head ________ of the hotel restaurant trained in Paris.

question.q: We need oil to ________ the potatoes until they are golden and crispy.
question.justification: لقلي البطاطس (fry) نحتاج زيت. السلق (boil) يحتاج ماء، والشوي (grill) على النار، والطهي بالبخار (steam) لا يحتاج زيتاً.
question.context_sentence: We need oil to ________ the potatoes until they are golden and crispy.

question.q: They decided to ________ the fish over charcoal for a smoky flavor.
question.justification: الدجاج على الفحم يُشوى (grill). السلق (boil) في ماء، والبخار (steam) بالبخار، والقلي (fry) بالزيت.
question.context_sentence: They decided to ________ the fish over charcoal for a smoky flavor.

question.q: You should ________ the water first before adding the pasta.
question.justification: يجب غلي الماء (boil) قبل إضافة الأرز. التجميد (freeze) والتبريد (cool) والخلط (mix) ليست خطوات طبخ الأرز.
question.context_sentence: You should ________ the water first before adding the pasta.

question.q: To keep the vitamins, it's better to ________ the vegetables rather than boil them.
question.justification: الطهي بالبخار (steam) يحافظ على القيمة الغذائية. القلي (fry) يدمر بعض الفيتامينات، والحرق (burn) يفسدها، والنيئة (raw) لا تطهى.
question.context_sentence: To keep the vitamins, it's better to ________ the vegetables rather than boil them.

question.q: We usually have a light ________ around noon.
question.justification: الغداء (lunch) هو وجبة الظهيرة. الفطور (breakfast) صباحاً، والعشاء (dinner) مساءً، والوجبة الخفيفة (snack) بين الوجبات.
question.context_sentence: We usually have a light ________ around noon.

question.q: I eat ________ at 7 AM every day before leaving for work.
question.justification: الساعة 7 صباحاً هي وقت الفطور (breakfast). الغداء (lunch) ظهراً، والعشاء (dinner) مساءً.
question.context_sentence: I eat ________ at 7 AM every day before leaving for work.

question.q: The family sits together in the evening for a traditional ________.
question.justification: في المساء تجتمع العائلة للعشاء (dinner). الغداء (lunch) ظهراً، والفطور (breakfast) صباحاً.
question.context_sentence: The family sits together in the evening for a traditional ________.

question.q: She sliced a fresh ________ to add to the salad.
question.justification: الخيار (cucumber) مكون شائع في السلطة. المعكرونة (pasta) والأرز (rice) والخبز (bread) ليست مكونات سلطة تقليدية.
question.context_sentence: She sliced a fresh ________ to add to the salad.

question.q: Italian cuisine is famous for its variety of ________ dishes.
question.justification: الإيطاليون يشتهرون بأكل المعكرونة (pasta). الأرز (rice) في آسيا، والخبز (bread) عام، والبطاطس (potatoes) في أوروبا.
question.context_sentence: Italian cuisine is famous for its variety of ________ dishes.

question.q: He is completely ________ to coffee and cannot start his day without it.
question.justification: مدمن القهوة (addicted) لا يستطيع التوقف عنها. الحساسية (allergic) رد فعل مناعي، ومعتاد (used) لا تعبر عن الإدمان، ومعارض (opposed) يعني رافض.
question.context_sentence: He is completely ________ to coffee and cannot start his day without it.

question.q: You can buy painkillers at the ________ on the corner.
question.justification: الأدوية تُشترى من الصيدلية (pharmacy). البنك (bank) للمال، والمطعم (restaurant) للطعام، والمرأب (garage) للسيارات.
question.context_sentence: You can buy painkillers at the ________ on the corner.

question.q: His monthly ________ is just enough to cover the bills.
question.justification: الدخل الشهري (income) هو ما يكسبه. المصروف (expense) ما ينفقه، والدين (debt) ما عليه، والفاتورة (bill) تدفع.
question.context_sentence: His monthly ________ is just enough to cover the bills.

question.q: For a light and healthy meal, she prepared a fresh green ________.
question.justification: السلطة (salad) وجبة صحية. الكعكة (cake) حلويات، والبرغر (burger) وجبات سريعة، والفطيرة (pie) مخبوزات.
question.context_sentence: For a light and healthy meal, she prepared a fresh green ________.

question.q: Japanese ________ is known for its delicate flavors and fresh ingredients.
question.justification: المطبخ الياباني (cuisine) مشهور عالمياً. اللغة (language) والطقس (weather) والنقل (transport) ليست أشياء تشتهر بها اليابان بنفس القدر.
question.context_sentence: Japanese ________ is known for its delicate flavors and fresh ingredients.

question.q: The old city is a UNESCO World ________ site, protected for future generations.
question.justification: اليابان لديها تراث (heritage) ثقافي غني. المشكلة (problem) والاقتصاد (economy) والكارثة (disaster) لا تصف الثقافة.
question.context_sentence: The old city is a UNESCO World ________ site, protected for future generations.

question.q: The country's ________ guarantees freedom of speech to all citizens.
question.justification: الدستور (constitution) هو الذي يحدد هيكل الحكومة. المجلة (magazine) والموقع الإلكتروني (website) والرسالة (letter) لا علاقة لها.
question.context_sentence: The country's ________ guarantees freedom of speech to all citizens.

question.q: The ________ plant turns seawater into drinking water.
question.justification: تحلية المياه (desalination) تزيل الملح من ماء البحر. الري (irrigation) للسقاية، والتبخر (evaporation) والكثافة (condensation) عمليات طبيعية.
question.context_sentence: The ________ plant turns seawater into drinking water.

question.q: Water is very scarce in the ________ desert regions.
question.justification: المناطق الجافة (arid) تحتاج التحلية. الممطرة (rainy) والباردة (cold) والخضراء (green) لديها مصادر مياه طبيعية.
question.context_sentence: Water is very scarce in the ________ desert regions.

question.q: Reverse osmosis uses a thin ________ to filter out salt and impurities.
question.justification: التناضح العكسي يستخدم غشاء (membrane) شبه منفذ. الأنبوب (pipe) والمضخة (pump) والخزان (tank) مكونات أخرى.
question.context_sentence: Reverse osmosis uses a thin ________ to filter out salt and impurities.

question.q: The waste ________ left after desalination can harm sea creatures.
question.justification: المحلول الملحي المركز (brine) يضر الحياة البحرية. الماء العادي (water) والزيت (oil) والعصير (juice) ليس لها نفس التأثير.
question.context_sentence: The waste ________ left after desalination can harm sea creatures.

question.q: Burning ________ like coal and oil releases harmful gases.
question.justification: الفحم والنفط وقود أحفوري (fossil fuels). المتجدد (renewable) والطاقة الشمسية (solar) والرياح (wind) مصادر طاقة نظيفة.
question.context_sentence: Burning ________ like coal and oil releases harmful gases.

question.q: ________ gases trap heat in the atmosphere and cause global warming.
question.justification: غازات الدفيئة (greenhouse) تسبب الاحتباس الحراري. الأكسجين (oxygen) والنيتروجين (nitrogen) والهيدروجين (hydrogen) غازات أخرى.
question.context_sentence: ________ gases trap heat in the atmosphere and cause global warming.

question.q: The ________ plains lie thousands of meters below the ocean surface.
question.justification: السهول السحيقة (abyssal) في أعماق المحيط. الضحلة (shallow) قريبة من السطح، والساحلية (coastal) قرب الشاطئ، والاستوائية (tropical) حارة.
question.context_sentence: The ________ plains lie thousands of meters below the ocean surface.

question.q: The ________ creatures glow in the dark depths of the ocean.
question.justification: أسماك الأعماق مضيئة حيوياً (bioluminescent). ليست غير مرئية (invisible) ولا عمياء (blind) ولا ليلية بالضرورة.
question.context_sentence: The ________ creatures glow in the dark depths of the ocean.

question.q: ________ vents on the seafloor release extremely hot water.
question.justification: الفتحات الحرمائية (hydrothermal) تطلق ماءً ساخناً جداً. الحرارية الأرضية (geothermal) عامة، والشمسية (solar) والكهربائية (electrical) لا تطلق ماء.
question.context_sentence: ________ vents on the seafloor release extremely hot water.

question.q: ________ is the pigment that makes leaves look green.
question.justification: الكلوروفيل (chlorophyll) يعطي اللون الأخضر. الكاروتينويد (carotenoid) أصفر/برتقالي، والأنثوسيانين (anthocyanin) أحمر/أرجواني، والميلانين (melanin) صبغة بشرية.
question.context_sentence: ________ is the pigment that makes leaves look green.

question.q: The yellow and orange colors of autumn leaves come from ________ pigments.
question.justification: الكاروتينويد (carotenoid) صبغة صفراء/برتقالية. الكلوروفيل (chlorophyll) أخضر، والأنثوسيانين (anthocyanin) أحمر/أرجواني.
question.context_sentence: The yellow and orange colors of autumn leaves come from ________ pigments.

question.q: Fallen leaves slowly ________ and turn into soil.
question.justification: الأوراق تتحلل (decompose) وتغني التربة. النمو (grow) والطيران (fly) والتجمد (freeze) لا يحدثان للأوراق المتساقطة.
question.context_sentence: Fallen leaves slowly ________ and turn into soil.

question.q: The artist used ________ colors to make the painting come alive.
question.justification: ألوان الخريف تكون زاهية (vibrant) في الأيام المشمسة. الباهتة (dull) والداكنة (dark) والضعيفة (faint) عكس ذلك.
question.context_sentence: The artist used ________ colors to make the painting come alive.

question.q: Plants absorb ________ from the soil through their roots.
question.justification: التربة تزود النباتات بالمغذيات (nutrients). الماء (water) والشمس (sunlight) والهواء (air) عوامل أخرى.
question.context_sentence: Plants absorb ________ from the soil through their roots.

question.q: The material is highly ________ to heat, so it's used in firefighter suits.
question.justification: الشبكة كانت مقاومة (resistant) للهجمات. الضعيفة (vulnerable/weak) تعني غير محمية، والمفتوحة (open) غير آمنة.
question.context_sentence: The material is highly ________ to heat, so it's used in firefighter suits.

question.q: The new ramp makes the building ________ to wheelchair users.
question.justification: الويب جعل الإنترنت متاحاً (accessible) للجميع. الصعب (difficult) والسري (secret) والخطير (dangerous) عكس ذلك.
question.context_sentence: The new ramp makes the building ________ to wheelchair users.

question.q: The ________ of data over fiber optic cables is extremely fast.
question.justification: البيانات تنتقل (transmission) عبر الكابلات. التجميع (collection) والتخزين (storage) والحذف (deletion) عمليات أخرى.
question.context_sentence: The ________ of data over fiber optic cables is extremely fast.

question.q: The fuel tank has a ________ of 60 litres.
question.justification: للبطاريات سعة (capacity) محدودة. الوزن (weight) والحجم (size) واللون (color) خصائص أخرى.
question.context_sentence: The fuel tank has a ________ of 60 litres.

question.q: Solar panels feed electricity into the national ________.
question.justification: الشبكة الذكية (smart grid) تدير الكهرباء. الطريق (road) والهاتف (phone) والماء (water) لا علاقة لها.
question.context_sentence: Solar panels feed electricity into the national ________.

question.q: We need to find ________ sources of energy that won't harm the planet.
question.justification: الطاقة الشمسية مستدامة (sustainable). المؤقتة (temporary) والخطيرة (dangerous) والغالية (expensive) لا تصفها.
question.context_sentence: We need to find ________ sources of energy that won't harm the planet.

question.q: The factory reduced its carbon ________ by installing filters.
question.justification: السيارات تنتج انبعاثات كربونية (emissions). الدخل (incomes) والأسعار (prices) والضوضاء (noise) ليست غازات.
question.context_sentence: The factory reduced its carbon ________ by installing filters.

question.q: The university received a research ________ to study renewable energy.
question.justification: المدينة تقدم منحاً (grants) للمشاريع الخضراء. الغرامات (fines) والضرائب (taxes) والحظر (bans) أمور سلبية.
question.context_sentence: The university received a research ________ to study renewable energy.
